lines.text: Add each sum up, then drag it to the number it makes!
Count all ten fingers — five on each hand!
Count each group, then drag the double that makes it!
Count each group, then drag the sum that makes it!
Count two fingers, then two more!
Count up! One... then one more!
Double trouble! Three plus three makes...?
Doubles are twin sums — the same number twice! Count each group, then drag its double onto it!
Eight stars! Five plus three makes eight! Dazzling!
Eight!
Five fish! Three plus two makes five!
Five plus five makes TEN flowers! The biggest double!
Five plus two makes seven watermelons! Yum!
Five pretzels! Three plus two makes five! What a feast!
Five stars were twinkling, then three more popped out! Tap every star!
Five!
Five! You're a one-more wizard!
Five, six, seven, eight! Counting on is an adding superpower!
Four balloons! Three plus one makes four!
Four butterflies were fluttering, then two more landed! Count them all!
Four frogs! Three and one more makes four!
Four juices! Two plus two makes four!
Four plus four makes eight balloons!
Four plus one makes five bananas!
Four plus one makes five!
Four!
Four! That's a double!
Four! Three, then four!
Four, then count up one!
Here's a big adding trick: you don't have to start at one! Hop on the train and count UP from where we start!
Hold up one finger, then one more, and count them!
Hooray! You finished every adventure on Plus Planet! You are a true Star Explorer!
I had one cookie, and I baked one more! One plus one makes...?
It's the great adding party! Show me everything you've learned, Explorer — every right answer sets off fireworks!
Last one! What is one more than four?
One bunny was hopping, and one more came! Tap each bunny and count!
One cookie, then one more! What is one more than one?
One plus four makes five!
One plus one makes two apples!
One plus one makes two socks — a pair!
One plus three makes four!
Party question one! What is one more than five?
Say five, then count one more!
Say two, then count one more!
Seven!
Six butterflies! Four plus two makes six!
Six!
Six! One more than five is six!
Six! You remembered your doubles!
Snack time on Plus Planet! Listen to my snack story, add the snacks together, and tap how many there are in all!
Start at three, count one more, then find that group!
Start at three, then count on two more! Four... five!
TEN! Five plus five makes ten! You're an adding superstar, Explorer! Fireworks for you!
The biggest party question! Five plus five makes...?
The sorting machine is mixed up! Work out each sum, then drag it to the number it makes!
The train starts at two! Tap two, then keep counting up!
These adding sums are looking for their groups! Count the fruit in each group, then drag the right sum onto it.
This train starts at three! Count on from three!
Three balloons plus one more balloon! Tap the group that shows three plus one!
Three chicks! Two and one more makes three!
Three cupcakes! Two plus one makes three!
Three fingers on each hand — count them all!
Three fish were swimming, then two more splashed in! Tap them all!
Three frogs were splashing, and one more hopped in! Count every one!
Three plus one makes four!
Three plus three makes six grapes!
Three plus three makes six ladybugs!
Three plus two makes five!
Three pretzels, and two more! Three plus two makes...?
Three!
Three! Two, then three!
Three, four, five, six! Choo choo!
Three, then the very next number!
Time for BIGGER sums! Some friends were playing, then more arrived. Tap every single one to count them all together!
Two bunnies! One and one more makes two!
Two chicks were playing, and one more joined! Count them all!
Two cookies! One plus one makes two!
Two cupcakes, and one more! Two plus one makes...?
Two juices, and two more! Two plus two makes...?
Two plus one makes three cars — that one was a sneaky non-double!
Two plus one makes three strawberries!
Two plus two makes four oranges!
Two plus two makes four paws!
Two plus two makes four!
Two plus two makes...?
Two!
Two! One more than one is two!
Two, three, four! You counted on!
Welcome to Plus Planet! Tap a glowing level to play!
Welcome to Plus Planet, Explorer! Adding means putting together. Watch — when one more friend hops in, the group gets bigger!
What is one more than three?
What is one more than two?
Wow! A new world just landed: Plus Planet! Let's go explore!
Wow, this train starts at five! Count on, Explorer!
Zibb loves one more of everything! When I say a number, tap the number that is one more!
